Name: [Smoke] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — Tab Visible on Launch
Precondition: Application installed; all dependencies available; sample Tx antenna files present in measurement_data/tx_antenna_files/.
Objective: Verify that the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab is visible and accessible after application launch.
Test Script (Step): Launch the Calibration Statistics Tool application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Main window opens without errors.

Test Script (Step): Navigate to the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): Tab is visible, labelled 'Tx Antenna Diagrams', and becomes active without errors.

Name: [Smoke] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — Default Widget States
Precondition: Application launched; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that all widgets on the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab display their expected default values.
Test Script (Step): Inspect the Input Setup group box.
Test Script (Expected Result): 'Target Angle' radio button is selected; 'Normal' sensor orientation is selected; 'Azimuth Diagrams' checkbox is checked; 'Elevation Diagrams' checkbox is checked.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the Plot Setup group box.
Test Script (Expected Result): Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide = 32; Graphs per Slide = 1; Image DPI = 220; X-Scale Autoscale unchecked; X-Scale Azimuth = 90; X-Scale Elevation = 45.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the Graph Configuration checkboxes.
Test Script (Expected Result): All six checkboxes (Level [dBm], Level Pow. Meter [dBm], Level Meas. Spec. [dBm], Level Meas. Pow. Meter [dBm], Frequency [MHz], Time [ms]) are checked by default.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the Plot Original / Normalised checkboxes.
Test Script (Expected Result): 'Plot Original Graphs' and 'Plot Normalised Graphs' are both checked.

Name: [Smoke] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — Start with Valid Data
Precondition: Protocol files including valid Tx antenna diagram files have been parsed; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab is open; default settings are applied.
Objective: Verify that pressing Start with valid parsed Tx antenna data produces a PPTX output without errors.
Test Script (Step): Ensure at least one protocol containing Tx antenna diagram files is loaded via the Parse Protocol tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol data is loaded successfully; no error shown.

Test Script (Step): On the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab, keep all default settings and click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing starts; progress/log messages appear without fatal errors.

Test Script (Step): Navigate to output_tx_diagrams/ and verify the output file.
Test Script (Expected Result): TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx is created in output_tx_diagrams/; file size > 0 bytes.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and check slide content.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains at least a Warnings/Errors slide, a Legend slide, a Sensor List table slide, and diagram slides per Tx antenna.

Name: [Smoke] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — Start with No Parsed Data
Precondition: Application launched; no protocol files have been parsed (or parsed data contains no Tx antenna diagram files); Tx Antenna Diagrams tab is open.
Objective: Verify that starting the script when no Tx antenna data is available produces a PPTX with an error summary instead of crashing.
Test Script (Step): On the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab, click 'Start' without loading any protocol data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without application crash.

Test Script (Step): Check the log panel or log file for the error message.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains 'No parsed Tx Antenna Diagram files found!' error entry.

Test Script (Step): Verify the output file in output_tx_diagrams/.
Test Script (Expected Result): TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx is created; it contains a Warnings and Errors slide with the error count and a separation sheet slide.

Name: [Smoke] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — Azimuth-Only Diagram Generation
Precondition: Valid protocol data with Tx antenna files loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that selecting Azimuth Diagrams only generates only azimuth diagram slides in the output PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck 'Elevation Diagrams' in the Input Setup group; keep 'Azimuth Diagrams' checked.
Test Script (Expected Result): Elevation Diagrams checkbox is unchecked; Azimuth Diagrams remains checked.

Test Script (Step): Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open the generated TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains azimuth diagram slides; no elevation diagram slides are present.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Target Angle vs PTU Angle Selection
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open; default settings applied.
Objective: Verify that switching between Target Angle and PTU Angle radio buttons correctly changes the angle display in the output diagrams.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Target Angle' radio button in the Input Setup group, then click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes; generated PPTX diagrams use target angle on the x-axis.

Test Script (Step): Select 'PTU Angle' radio button in the Input Setup group, then click 'Start' again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes; generated PPTX diagrams use PTU angle on the x-axis; slide metadata reflects the angle type change.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Upside-Down Sensor Orientation
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that selecting Upside-Down sensor orientation inverts the angle data in the output diagrams.
Test Script (Step): Set Sensor Orientation to 'Normal', click 'Start', and note the angle values in the generated diagrams.
Test Script (Expected Result): Diagrams generated with normal orientation; angle data as measured.

Test Script (Step): Set Sensor Orientation to 'Upside-Down', click 'Start', and compare the generated diagrams.
Test Script (Expected Result): Diagrams generated with inverted angle data compared to the Normal orientation run; no crash.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Elevation-Only Diagram Generation
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that uncheck Azimuth and keeping Elevation checked generates only elevation diagram slides.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck 'Azimuth Diagrams' and ensure 'Elevation Diagrams' is checked. Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open the generated TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains elevation diagram slides only; no azimuth diagram slides are present.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — X-Scale Autoscale Toggle
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that enabling X-Scale Autoscale ignores the manual X-Scale Azimuth and X-Scale Elevation values and scales automatically.
Test Script (Step): Set X-Scale Azimuth to 45 and X-Scale Elevation to 20. Uncheck 'X-Scale Autoscale'. Click 'Start'. Note diagram x-axis range.
Test Script (Expected Result): Diagrams use ±45° azimuth and ±20° elevation x-axis range.

Test Script (Step): Check 'X-Scale Autoscale'. Click 'Start' again. Note diagram x-axis range.
Test Script (Expected Result): X-axis range is determined automatically from the data; ±45° / ±20° manual values are not applied.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Manual X-Scale Values Validation
Precondition: Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open; X-Scale Autoscale unchecked.
Objective: Verify that the X-Scale Azimuth and X-Scale Elevation fields accept valid integer values within 0–150 and reject out-of-range input.
Test Script (Step): Enter 90 in X-Scale Azimuth and 45 in X-Scale Elevation. Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes; diagrams display ±90° azimuth and ±45° elevation range.

Test Script (Step): Attempt to enter 200 in the X-Scale Azimuth field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Field rejects the value or clamps to the maximum; no value above 150 is accepted.

Test Script (Step): Attempt to enter a non-integer string in the X-Scale Elevation field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Field rejects the non-integer input; previous valid value is retained.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Graphs per Slide Configuration
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; at least 2 Tx antennas available in parsed data; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that setting Graphs per Slide to 1, 2, 3, and 4 produces correctly formatted PPTX slides.
Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 1 and click 'Start'. Open the PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each diagram slide contains exactly one graph.

Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 2 and click 'Start'. Open the PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each diagram slide contains two graphs per slide.

Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 4 and click 'Start'. Open the PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each diagram slide contains four graphs per slide.

Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to an invalid value (e.g., enter 0 or 5 if the field allows).
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains 'Invalid graphPerSlide configuration' error; no diagram slides generated beyond the header slides.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Plot Original Only
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that unchecking Plot Normalised Graphs produces only original (non-normalised) diagram slides.
Test Script (Step): Ensure 'Plot Original Graphs' is checked and uncheck 'Plot Normalised Graphs'. Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open the generated TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect slide titles.
Test Script (Expected Result): Slides contain only original graph titles (no 'Norm.' prefix in titles); normalised graph slides are absent.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Plot Normalised Only
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that unchecking Plot Original Graphs produces only normalised diagram slides.
Test Script (Step): Ensure 'Plot Normalised Graphs' is checked and uncheck 'Plot Original Graphs'. Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open the generated TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect slide titles.
Test Script (Expected Result): Slides contain only normalised graph titles ('Norm.' prefix present); original graph slides are absent.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Graph Configuration Individual Toggle
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open; all graph config checkboxes enabled.
Objective: Verify that disabling individual graph type checkboxes removes the corresponding diagram type from the output PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck 'Level [dBm]' in Graph Configuration. Click 'Start'. Open PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): No slides with 'Level [dBm]' graph type are present in the PPTX.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck all Graph Configuration checkboxes. Click 'Start'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains 'No graphs configured!' error; only header/warning slides are generated in the PPTX.

Test Script (Step): Re-check only 'Frequency [MHz]'. Click 'Start'. Open PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Only Frequency diagram slides are present; no Level or Time slides.

Name: [Regression] ui.handlers.tx_ant_diag_handlers — Sensor Slide Count Limit
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with more than 32 sensor measurements loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that the Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide field limits the number of sensor measurements shown in the sensor list table.
Test Script (Step): Set Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide to 10. Click 'Start'. Open PPTX and inspect the sensor list table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sensor list table shows at most 10 sensor measurement entries.

Test Script (Step): Set Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide to 0. Click 'Start'. Open PPTX and inspect the sensor list table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sensor list table contains no entries; no crash occurs.

Name: [Regression] ui.tabs.tx_ant_diag_tab — PPTX Output Slide Structure Integrity
Precondition: Valid protocol data with two or more Tx antennas loaded; all default settings applied; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that the generated PPTX follows the expected slide order: Warnings/Errors, Separation Sheet, Legend, Sensor List table, then diagram slides per Tx antenna.
Test Script (Step): Click 'Start' with two or more Tx antennas present in the parsed data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect slide order.
Test Script (Expected Result): Slide 1: Warnings and Errors summary. Slide 2: Separation sheet titled 'Tx Antenna Diagrams'. Slide 3: Legend slide. Slide 4: Sensor list table. Remaining slides: diagram slides grouped by TxAnt index and graph type.

Test Script (Step): Verify slide titles contain the TxAnt index and center frequency info.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each diagram slide title includes 'Tx Antenna Diagrams', the diagram type (Azimuth/Elevation), and 'TxAntN: CentFreq. = X.XX GHz'.

Test Script (Step): Close the application cleanly.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application exits without crash or error.
